# tidymsi <a href="https://joe-m-shaw.github.io/tidymsi/"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="250" alt="tidymsi website" /></a>

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/joe-m-shaw/tidymsi/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/joe-m-shaw/tidymsi)
<!-- badges: end -->

`tidymsi` is a package which helps to convert microsatellite instability (MSI)
results into a tidy format for data analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of tidymsi from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("joe-m-shaw/tidymsi")
```
